name: grebe
description: DuckDB SQL diagnostics, quick fixes and formatting via the grebe LSP server

grebe.path.description: Path to the grebe executable (default: ~/.local/bin/grebe if it exists, otherwise `grebe` on PATH)

grebe.select.description: The MOD rules to lint for, same as the grebe CLI's --select flag. Only the MOD rules listed here run, and any of them that are off by default are turned on. The default lists every MOD rule so the editor shows all of them; remove a code to stop seeing it. Parse errors (PRS) and other-dialect notices (SRC) are always shown unless set to off in grebe.toml's [severity].
